headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: City road is a mess!!!  Vehicle used to “clean” it up has no mud flaps and throws mud and dirt onto vehicles behind it. Where do we submit claim to COA for broken windshield?  Consistently ignored and dismissed once submitted to 311

Metal plates covering up trench dug across roadway are loud and obnoxious when being run over by cars. It sounds like a large garbage truck emptying a commercial metal dumpster when a car passes over them... ALL THRU THE NIGHT.  Please repair with asphalt ASAP. THIS IS INAPPROPRIATE.

Victory Lap on the west campus of UT is playing Heavy Metal music outside very loud. Historically, I know that they didn't have a permit. I'm guessing they still don't have a permit. It's so loud! They've been issued so many citations, yet they still play loud music. Why aren't there harsher consequences? They're effectively screaming into a microphone.

PACK OF 7 LOOSE STRAYS. Four adult dogs and two puppies. Husky mix. Attacking other dogs who are on leashes. Getting into trash cans. Have become a nuisance. Please send an animal protection officer. They are sleeping under cars or on driveways. They are located on Upland Willow Rd, 78724. Usually hanging around the address 15208 Upland Willow Rd.  Austin,78724

Within the last week, the City has changed the bike lane design on Mesa from something that was straight and problem free to a zig-zag ABSOLUTELY DANGEROUS design. The photo is the proof: an experienced rider down with a concussion, broken bones and currently in Dell Seaton hospital. This is the sixth major-injury crash I’ve seen from these horrific bike lane designs.

The new sign which was put up at the end of the parking lot I park my car in is in the way and visitors have already backed into it because it's blocking free access. Can you please remove it… And this goes along with the previous ticket I submitted, but who requested that a bike lane be put in in the first place? Could you advise me on that process and to whom I should contact to register a co…

Why has this road been closed for weeks? Never any work happening or workers on site.Only 2 streets to get into the entire n’hood from 183 so causes a big detour to get to the other- (floral park) and that road is down to one lane for both directions at the intersection for Austin Water works. This is dangerous for EMS/fire etc trying to get into or out of the area and shouldn’t be allowed for …

The cars parking overnight in northwest park leave during the day and return in the evening. EVERY evening. Going to the park to monitor in the afternoon is not going to address the issue. Please let me know who I should reach out to in order to solve the matter. People are camping in the park overnight. Kids are drinking and doing drugs there. It isn’t safe for the car campers and it isn’t saf…

Overgrown vegetation is completely obstructing the public sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the roadway. This creates a significant safety hazard and an ADA accessibility barrier for individuals using wheelchairs, walkers, and strollers. Please inspect the location and require the vegetation to be trimmed to restore safe, accessible sidewalk passage.
Noise at 90dBA!  Why don’t bands need to follow the noise ordinance laws?  Rainey - Victory Lap / Bungalow.  LV Collective should be fined!

Another weekend, another night Watr’s bass is shaking our apartment... The music seems to get louder the later it gets. They also constantly play past their permit’s cutoff time Please turn them down!

Dog loose at 314 1/2 W Koenig Ln along Waller Creek. Went to check on him and he is unleashed but has a collar. He ran down the hill along wall Creek away from me. He is in the area along the creek behind the house is along Chesterfield. It is raining and he looks scared. He is blonde and white.

I live at 8925 Vigen and I was going to walk my small dogs and opened our gate and a German Shepard charged after my dog. Luckily I was able to grab mine back inside the gate and screamed and the dog ran off. This is the third time I’ve seen loose German Shepards in this neighborhood. I don’t know where they are coming from but it has to be close and we need patrol to find where they are escapi…

Same camper is back at Armadillo Park, screaming at people, using the park as her toilet. With the cooler weather neighbors cannot se it out in their yards or let their kids play outside because of the things being yelled across the park.  There are more visitors now due to the Water Tower mural who stop to walk the park and are confronted by this mentally disturbed woman.

Cars parked overnight in northwest park parking lot. They are there every morning. Suspect they are car camping. This park needs attention. Kids drink and get high-one was killed in the parking lot recently. Car camping has been going on for over a year. Nothing has been done despite reports.

There is a lot of dangerous debris in the bike lanes on Georgian Dr. Just north of Powell, hundreds of small nails are scattered in the bike lane. There's also other debris along the full length of Georgian, including glass, car part debris, large piles of leaves, gravel, etc.

Vehicles from the apartment complex parking in the bike lane. Also, the Dodge Charger has been sitting in the same spot for approximately two to three months. It has a red tag on it, and all four tires are flat. Is there any way we can have this vehicle towed and removed from the bike lane? It’s becoming an ongoing issue, and it continues to create an obstruction for people trying to use the bi…

There was a big rock on the street cross heatherwilde & well branch. This morning I went over the rock before 7 AM. It was dark and raining this morning. I didn’t notice the rock and I went over the rock. My front lower bumper got damaged and the engine oil started leaking.

Regarding new construction in progress at 2811 E. 22nd St. Required tree protection fencing is not intact. Quarter CRZ is being used for material stockpiling and site access, causing concern about damage to the existing large tree(s) to remain.

A Tiguan is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed.

Once again, Tchiadai Food Truck continues to blare amplified music outside on a Bluetooth speaker despite multiple warnings, requests and visits by 311. It it currently 1:36am and the music can be heard upstairs in the residential building across the street.

Loose dog on Water Well Lane at 20:46 am today 11/16. Dog is repeatedly loose and is owned by 2401 Water Well Lane. Animal control was knocking on his door yesterday at 9:30 am. Not sure if contact was made at that time. This dog is out every day.

Repeat complaint about the same dog. See SR 26-00361929, job #51147. Today the dog was off leash and roaming with a young girl, with no adult present. It ran back and forth across Miami Drive, entered our yard, and defecated without pickup (again). A passing truck nearly hit the dog. The dog also barked aggressively at a neighbor who was outside. This is a safety risk to the dog, drivers, and n…

Dog loose on Village West Dr — no owner in sight. Other neighbors have stated the owner believes the dog should be allowed to free roam. Besides the mandated leash law, have dogs free roam our neighborhood streets poses a risk to drivers and the dog alike. Dog’s name is Lily. Owner lives at 1123 San Augustine.

We have had 4, possibly 5 dogs trashing our fenced in property for months. We have reported them, posted images on Nextdoor, asked neighbors if they knew who they belonged to, etc. they are doing a considerable amount of damage, growl if you get closer. They dug more plants today and I caught them on video. They saw me and turned my way, I ran into the house. These are large dogs, and I don’t f…

Empty food and water bowls. Officer performed a wellness check and said dog was skinny and there was a lot of poop in there. Building 3. 3rd floor. Looking at the dog park. This is the 4th day the dog has spent most of the day outside. Last night he was crying and the soulless human inside wouldn’t let him in (have video of that)

Dog has been outside for 3 days. 6:45 am he’s there. 1 pm he’s outside. 6:30 pm again outside. It is now 11:46 pm and I have a video of him being outside and crying asking to be let in and being ignored. I can’t tell if the dog has a full water bowl or even food. He’s sad looking through the balcony or looking inside. Usually the blinds are closed. Building 3, 3rd floor at Lakeline Crossing com…

Commercial semi-trucks, dump trailers, and heavy commercial vehicles are illegally parked overnight and continuously along Jourdan Crossing Blvd. These oversized trucks block driver sightlines for left-turning traffic exiting the neighborhood. The adjacent church parking lots and playground are empty. The same trucks are always there and there can be 5 or 6 commercial trucks at a time.

Vehicle parked wrong way. A ticket was opened earlier today which was closed 10 minutes ago stating the vehicle was gone on arrival. The vehcile never moved and is still there. my security camera shows parking authority never even drove down the street

This morning around 6:45 AM on 11/16, I ran over to the big rock and that damaged my front lower bumper and engine oil started leaking. It happened cross heatherwilde and wells branch. It was still dark and raining and I didn’t see there was a rock on the wells branch road.

I would like to report ongoing illegal dumping at the end of a residential cul-de-sac in our neighborhood.

This area has increasingly become a dumping ground for discarded tires, trash, and other debris. The accumulation is unsightly, creates potential health and environmental concerns, and negatively affects the surrounding neighborhood.

I’m requesting that the City investigate the location,…

Large dying elm on Boggy Creek is losing massive limbs by the week. If more limbs fall, this will cause flooding. Need the city to remove it

The music is absurdly loud, not just slightly disruptive. As in can be heard inside of houses with background noise on in every room blocks away.
